{{Quote|My brother was sent to the country to work in a munitions factory, I have not heard a word from him since.|Cerasi|<ref name="The Defenders of the Dead" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Melida/Legends|Melida]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]<ref name="The Defenders of the Dead" /> was the older<ref name="The Uncertain Path">''[[Jedi Apprentice: The Uncertain Path]]''</ref> '''brother''' of [[Cerasi]], one of the leaders of [[The Young]].<ref name="The Defenders of the Dead" /> The son of Melida leader [[Wehutti]] and [[Wehutti's wife|his wife]],<ref name="The Uncertain Path" /> the boy lived in the planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Zehava]] until he was sent to work in a munitions factory in the countryside. Cerasi never heard from him again.<ref name="The Defenders of the Dead" />
